name: SpecsMap Plugin UI
description: SpecsMap dependency graph viewer DOM and interactions. Documents the header bar with counts/buttons/validation badge, the graph viewport with SVG edge layer and HTML node layer, the empty state, the sliding detail panel, and the settings panel. Covers hover-highlight, node selection, pan/zoom, refresh, fit-to-view, settings toggling, and file-open interactions.

dom.root: this.el — flex column div containing header and content area

elements.header: div (this.el first child) — padding:3px 10px 3px 12px, font-size:11px, font-weight:700, letter-spacing:1.5px, color:var(--accent), border-bottom:1px solid var(--border), user-select:none, display:flex, align-items:center, gap:10px
elements.header_sub: .sm-header-sub — font-size:10px, color:var(--tertiary), font-weight:400, letter-spacing:0.3px, text-transform:none, flex-shrink:0. Displays spec file count and parse status
elements.validation_badge: span — font-size:11px, font-weight:700, color:var(--green) on success or var(--red) on failure. Shows parsed/total count (e.g. '28/28')
elements.search_btn: button.sm-header-btn — toggles search bar. Shows magnifying glass SVG icon. title='Search nodes (Ctrl+F)'
elements.cycle_btn: button.sm-header-btn — toggles cycle detection mode. Shows cycle indicator when cycles detected
elements.refresh_btn: button.sm-header-btn — triggers refresh(). Disabled during loading, SVG spinner class during reload
elements.fit_btn: button.sm-header-btn — triggers fitGraph(). Eye icon SVG
elements.viewport: div — position:absolute, inset:0, overflow:hidden, contain:layout style. Contains svg, nodeLayer, and emptyState
elements.svg_graph: svg.sm-graph — position:absolute, inset:0, pointer-events:none, z-index:1, overflow:visible. Contains edge path elements and arrow marker defs
elements.node_layer: div — position:absolute, inset:0, z-index:2. Contains absolutely positioned .sm-node elements. Will-change:transform during pan, CSS transform for pan/zoom
elements.empty_state: div — position:absolute, inset:0, display:none, flex column, center aligned, z-index:10. Shows 'No spec files found' with 'Generate Specs' button when empty
elements.panel: .sm-panel-el — position:absolute, right:0, top:0, bottom:0, width:320px, background:var(--surface), border-left:1px dashed var(--border), z-index:20. Transform:translateX(100%) when closed, translateX(0) when open. flex column with overflow:hidden
elements.search_bar: .sm-search-bar — position:absolute, top:0, left:0, right:0, height:34px, z-index:25, background:var(--panel), border-bottom:1px dashed var(--border). Flex row with align-items:center, gap:6px, padding:0 10px. transform:translateY(-100%) opacity:0 pointer-events:none when closed. Slides down to translateY(0) opacity:1 pointer-events:auto when open. Contains search icon, input, count span, close button
elements.search_input: input element — flex:1, font-family:Space Mono, background:var(--bg), border:1px solid var(--border), border-radius:5px, padding:3px 8px, font-size:12px, color:var(--primary). placeholder 'Type to search nodes…'
elements.search_count: span — font-size:10px, color:var(--tertiary), flex-shrink:0, min-width:28px, text-align:right. Shows match count
elements.search_close: button — '×', background:none, border:none, color:var(--tertiary), font-size:16px. Click calls closeSearch()

node_structure.container: .sm-node — position:absolute, border:1px dashed var(--border), border-radius:8px, background:var(--surface), cursor:pointer, transition:box-shadow 0.15s border-color 0.15s opacity 0.15s, box-shadow:var(--shadow), overflow:visible. Width/height from computeLayout()
node_structure.head: .sm-node-head — display:flex, align-items:center, gap:6px, min-width:0. Contains .sm-dot, .sm-name, .sm-layer-badge
node_structure.dot: .sm-dot — width:8px, height:8px, border-radius:50%, flex-shrink:0. Colored by LAYER_COLORS_HEX (foundation:#4ade80, core:#5a8af4, widget:#a78bfa, modal:#fbbf24, overlay:#f87171, plugin:#94a3b8)
node_structure.name: .sm-name — font-size:13px, font-weight:700, color:var(--primary), overflow:hidden, text-overflow:ellipsis, white-space:nowrap
node_structure.meta: .sm-meta — font-size:10px, color:var(--secondary), margin-top:auto, display:flex, gap:6px. Shows dep/ref counts
node_structure.ui_node: .sm-node-ui — applied to UI sub-spec nodes. .sm-name font-size:11px, .sm-file font-size:10px, .sm-dot width:6px height:6px opacity:0.6
node_structure.port_dots: Four port dots on main node borders: top-left (incoming), top-right (outgoing), bottom-left (outgoing), bottom-right (incoming). Used as SVG edge routing endpoints
node_structure.layer_header: .sm-layer-header — position:absolute, font-size:13px, font-weight:700, letter-spacing:1.5px, user-select:none, pointer-events:none, opacity:0.45. Absolutely positioned labels for each layer row

interactions.name: hover_node
interactions.action: Highlight connected nodes: set border style to solid with 2px thickness and LAYER_COLORS_VAR glow box-shadow, set opacity to 1. Animate connected edges: increase stroke-width, add dash-array animation (.sm-edge-active class with sm-flow keyframe). Dim unrelated nodes: set opacity to 0.14
interactions.result: Connected subgraph visually emphasized; unrelated nodes dimmed

interactions.name: unhover_node
interactions.action: Restore all .sm-node elements to default opacity (1). Restore all edge path elements to default stroke-width and remove .sm-edge-active class
interactions.result: All nodes and edges return to default visual state

interactions.name: select_node
interactions.action: Deselect previous (remove .sm-selected class from all nodes) → add .sm-selected class (solid border) to clicked node → zoom-to-node: animated pan+scale to center node with 300ms ease-out cubic transition → open detail panel from right (translateX(0) on .sm-panel-el, renderPanel() with dependencies, referencers, IPC channels, 'Open File' link)
interactions.result: Node highlighted with solid border, viewport smoothly pans/zooms to center the node, detail panel slides in from right with full spec information

interactions.name: deselect_all
interactions.trigger: click on viewport background (not on .sm-node or panel)
interactions.action: Remove .sm-selected class from all nodes → closePanel(): set panel transform to translateX(100%), clear panelInner innerHTML
interactions.result: Selection cleared, detail panel slides out to right

interactions.name: pan_canvas
interactions.gesture: mousedown: capture panStartX/Y and panStartPanX/Y, set isPanning=true → mousemove: requestAnimationFrame-throttled update: panX=panStartPanX+(mouseX-panStartX), panY=panStartPanY+(mouseY-panStartY), apply CSS transform → mouseup: isPanning=false, clear cursor/will-change styles
interactions.action: Translate SVG and nodeLayer via CSS transform: translate(panX px, panY px) scale(scale)
interactions.result: Graph canvas panned to new position

interactions.name: zoom
interactions.action: Cursor-centered scale change: newScale = clamp(scale * (deltaY > 0 ? 0.9 : 1.1), fitScale, fitScale * 3). Adjust panX/panY so cursor position stays fixed: panX = cursorX - (cursorX - panX) * (newScale / scale); panY = cursorY - (cursorY - panY) * (newScale / scale). Apply CSS transform
interactions.result: Graph zooms in/out centered on cursor position, clamped to valid range

interactions.name: refresh
interactions.action: Disable button, add .sm-spinning class to SVG icon → clear state (nodes, specRawMap, nodeEls, SVG, panel, cycle/isolation modes) → call buildFromFiles() to read spec directory via IPC fs:readDir, parse main.spec.json and individual feature specs, compute layout, render nodes/edges → save snapshot to .cockpit/specsmap.json via IPC fs:writeFile → update validation badge counts → re-enable button, remove spinner
interactions.result: Entire graph rebuilt from current spec files; snapshot cached for next load

interactions.name: fit_view
interactions.action: Calculate bounding box of all nodes (min/max x/y) → compute target scale = Math.min(viewportWidth/(maxX-minX+2*GRAPH_MARGIN), viewportHeight/(maxY-minY+2*GRAPH_MARGIN)) → compute target pan to center → animate pan and scale with 300ms ease-out cubic transition
interactions.result: Viewport smoothly animates to show all nodes centered and visible

interactions.name: open_settings
interactions.action: Toggle cycleMode: detect dependency cycles via DFS on dependency graph → if cycles found, set cycleMode=true, render cycle level indicator, apply cycle border colors to cycle member nodes → clicking cycle button again advances cycleLevel through detected cycles. When in cycle mode with an active cycle, isolatedMode activates: dims non-cycle nodes to opacity 0.14, applies sm-flow-fast dashed border animation to cycle members
interactions.result: Dependency cycles highlighted with colored borders; non-cycle members dimmed when isolation is active

interactions.name: open_file
interactions.trigger: click on 'Open File' link in detail panel
interactions.action: Read data-open-file attribute from clicked element → fire this.onFileOpen?.(filePath) callback
interactions.result: CanvasArea opens the source file in the active Explorer plugin's Monaco editor

interactions.name: open_search
interactions.trigger: click on magnifying glass button in header, or Ctrl+F/Cmd+F on keyboard
interactions.action: Slide search bar down from top of content area (transform:translateY(0), opacity:1). Focus search input. Set searchBtn color to accent
interactions.result: Search bar visible at top of viewport, input focused

interactions.name: close_search
interactions.trigger: click × button, blur on input, Escape key, or Ctrl+F/Cmd+F when search is open
interactions.action: Slide search bar up (transform:translateY(-100%), opacity:0). Restore all node opacities to 1. Restore all .sm-name innerHTML to original text. Clear searchResults, searchQuery, searchIndex
interactions.result: Search bar hidden, nodes return to normal appearance

interactions.name: search_type
interactions.action: Call performSearch(query). If query non-empty: iterate this.nodes and this.specRawMap, match against name/specFile/sourceFile/layer/description/dependencies/referenced_by/ipc (all case-insensitive). Dim non-matching nodes to opacity 0.14. Select first match and highlight keyword in .sm-name. Update searchCountEl. If query empty: restore all nodes
interactions.result: Matching nodes highlighted, non-matching dimmed; count displayed; first result selected with keyword highlight

interactions.name: search_next
interactions.action: goToNext(): increment searchIndex (wrap), call selectNode(resultId, true). Zoom to node, open detail panel, highlight keyword in selected .sm-name via sm-search-mark span (background:var(--accent), color:var(--bg))
interactions.result: Next matching node selected, zoomed to, with keyword highlighted in its name

interactions.name: search_prev
interactions.action: goToPrev(): decrement searchIndex (wrap), call selectNode(resultId, true). Zoom to node, open detail panel, highlight keyword in selected .sm-name
interactions.result: Previous matching node selected, zoomed to, with keyword highlighted in its name

states.empty: No spec files found in workspace's src/specs/ directory. Header shows '0/0' badge. Viewport shows emptyState div with centered message 'No spec files found' and a 'Generate Specs' button. Refresh available to retry.
states.loading: Refresh button disabled. Refresh button SVG icon has .sm-spinning class (CSS rotation animation). Header sub shows 'loading...'. Graph area blank while loading.
states.loaded: Graph rendered with full node set. Validation badge shows green 'N/N' (all parsed) or amber 'M/N' (some failed). Nodes positioned by computeLayout() with rows of up to 10 per layer, centered horizontally. SVG edges drawn as cubic bezier curves between port dots. Layer headers visible as dimmed absolute labels.
states.panel_open: Detail panel visible (translateX(0) from right). Selected node has .sm-selected class with solid border. Panel header shows spec name and close button. Panel body shows sections: source file, layer badge, dependencies list (name + file + usage), referencers list, IPC channels list. 'Open File' link at bottom with data-open-file attribute.
states.settings_open: cycleMode is true. Cycle button shows cycle level indicator (e.g. 'C1' for first cycle). Nodes in current cycle have colored highlight borders. If multiple cycles exist, clicking cycle button advances through levels.
states.search_open: Search bar visible at top of viewport (translateY(0)). Input focused with blinking cursor. Non-matching nodes dimmed to opacity 0.14. Matching nodes at full opacity. Selected node has .sm-selected class and keyword highlighted in .sm-name with .sm-search-mark span (accent bg). Search count shows N matches. Close × visible
states.search_empty: Search bar visible, input empty. All nodes at full opacity (no dimming). Count shows '0'. Typing triggers search; backspace to empty restores all nodes.

rendering.node_layout: computeLayout() groups nodes by layer (foundation bottom → plugin top). Within each layer, nodes arranged in rows of up to MAX_PER_ROW (10), left-to-right, centered horizontally. Row height equals node height + NODE_GAP. NODE_W=280, NODE_H=100 for main nodes. NODE_UI_W=230, NODE_UI_H=62 for UI sub-spec nodes with UI_OFFSET_Y=64 vertical offset from parent
rendering.edge_curves: curvePoints() generates cubic bezier SVG paths with directional port routing. Paths originate from port dots (28px offsets from corners) — outgoing from bottom-left/top-right, incoming at top-left/bottom-right. Arrow markers via SVG <marker> defs at path endpoints. Glow layers rendered as duplicate paths with lower opacity and wider stroke
rendering.transform: CSS transform: translate(panX px, panY px) scale(scale) applied to both SVG and nodeLayer elements simultaneously. During animated transitions, CSS transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94)
rendering.reduced_motion: prefers-reduced-motion media query disables sm-flow and sm-flow-fast CSS animations. Transition durations halved or removed

lifecycle.created_by: CanvasArea.addSpecsmap() — DOM container created by PluginCard, SpecsMapPlugin constructor builds full UI, immediately calls loadSpecs()
lifecycle.destroyed_by: Card terminate → SpecsMapPlugin.destroy() removes document-level mousemove/mouseup listeners, clears nodeEls and specRawMap maps. PluginCard then removes DOM container
